basic_info.description: This centrally located condo sits at the crossroads of four distinct neighborhoods: The Castro, Hayes Valley, Duboce Triangle, and Mission Dolores. Overlooking a serene interior courtyard, this is a true private retreat in the heart of the city. Thoughtfully designed, the home features a private balcony, sleek wood floors, brand-new bedroom carpeting, in-unit laundry, and an open contemporary kitchen perfect for entertaining. Built in 2014, Linea offers top-tier amenities, including a dedicated lobby attendant, garage parking, and a stunning shared roof deck with panoramic city views. Just steps from Whole Foods, Muni, BART, and tech shuttles. Vibrant dining, shopping, and nightlife options are right outside your door. Don't miss this exceptional urban oasis! (Some images have been virtually enhanced)
